accessGuide.note: Walking times are approximate, from the station exit to a shopping-centre entrance.

accessGuide.mrt: Another city train network. Its Blue line connects with BTS at Asok / Sukhumvit. The BTS station is called Asok; the MRT station is called Sukhumvit.

research.method: Station exits and connection types use the linked venue, rail-operator and tourism-authority sources. Minute ranges are approximate planning estimates from exits to entrances, not surveyed journey times; CentralWorld and Central Embassy estimates are informed by TAT descriptions. Map positions are schematic and do not encode distance.

services: A space for a new collection, a product display or a first visit to the city. Rental options are available at all five locations, with a choice of dates, space sizes and setup.
A launch can bring your products and brand story to a new audience. Displays, signs and event space can be arranged to match the location and the collection.
From clothing rails and a sales counter to display lights and fitting areas, setup can be simple or more complete. Extra storage and printed signs are also available.
For permanent stores, space size, design and lease length are agreed separately. Each of our location profiles gives a view of the shopping offer and the surrounding area.
Delivery access, opening times and the exact space are confirmed with the final offer. Staff, stock and payment equipment are arranged separately.
terms: Rent covers the full stay shown in the table. Setup is charged once. Extra stock storage is charged for the full stay. Printed brand signs are charged once.
The refundable deposit is paid before opening. It is returned after the space is checked, if there is no damage or unpaid charge.
Staff, stock, payment equipment, electricity and taxes are not included.
An estimate does not reserve a space. Exact dates and the position of the space are confirmed before booking.

venues.name: CentralWorld
venues.access: BTS Chit Lom, Exit 1: about 3–5 minutes on foot by a covered raised walkway. BTS Siam, Exit 4, is also connected by a longer raised-walkway route.
venues.intro: Put your brand among international fashion, food, beauty and entertainment in the centre of Bangkok.
venues.character: CentralWorld has a wide choice of clothing and sportswear. Uniqlo, Zara, Adidas and Nike are among the brands here. Visitors can shop, meet friends and spend a full day at the centre.
venues.neighbourhood: Ratchaprasong brings together large shopping centres, department stores and hotels. International fashion brands sit alongside luxury shopping at nearby Gaysorn Village. Events and seasonal promotions add to the activity around CentralWorld.
venues.business: A shop here can bring a new collection close to well-known fashion brands. There is room for a strong window display and a clear brand message. Different areas of the centre offer different settings for a launch.
venues.beyond: Restaurants, beauty stores, technology shops and entertainment bring people to the centre throughout the day. Fashion is part of a much wider shopping offer.
venues.unknown: Available spaces and nearby shops vary by date. Details of events, visitor numbers and the location of each space are available on enquiry.
venues.terms: A 60 m² space with clothing rails, a small fitting area and a brand display. The setup price covers basic rails, lighting and a counter. Staff, stock, payment equipment, electricity and taxes cost extra.

venues.name: Siam Center
venues.type: Thai design · Street fashion · Creative retail
venues.access: BTS Siam, Exit 2: about 1–2 minutes on foot by a direct station link. Both BTS lines stop here.
venues.intro: Give your brand a home among fashion, design and new ideas in the Siam shopping district.
venues.character: Siam Center brings together fashion, art, beauty and lifestyle shops. Thai designers are an important part of the offer. Absolute Siam Store sells products from several Thai brands.
venues.neighbourhood: Siam is a busy shopping area with fashion shops, cafés and several large shopping centres. Siam Square is nearby, with smaller shops and places to eat. Siam Paragon and Siam Discovery are also close.
venues.business: This is a place for new styles and brands with a clear identity. Clothing, accessories and creative displays are part of the shopping experience. A small collection can sit alongside Thai fashion and international styles.
venues.beyond: Beauty products, lifestyle shops, food and creative events add to the fashion offer. Visitors can explore more than clothing during their visit.
venues.unknown: The final space, fitting-room arrangements and nearby brands are confirmed with each proposal. Promotion within the centre is available by agreement.
venues.terms: A 40 m² space for a small collection, trying on clothes and talking with customers. Basic rails, a mirror and a counter are included in the setup price. Staff, stock, payment equipment, electricity and taxes cost extra.

venues.name: Terminal 21 Asok
venues.access: BTS Asok, Exit 1: about 1–2 minutes via the covered raised link. MRT Sukhumvit, Exit 3: about 2–3 minutes on foot.
venues.intro: Bring your collection to a shopping centre where local shops meet visitors from across the city.
venues.character: Terminal 21 Asok has an airport theme. Different areas are based on cities such as Tokyo, London and San Francisco. Local shops sell fashion alongside restaurants and entertainment.
venues.neighbourhood: The centre is in Asok, where office buildings, hotels, restaurants and shops meet. The BTS and MRT stations connect this area with other parts of Bangkok.
venues.business: Smaller shops give this centre a different feel from a row of large international stores. A compact space can show a focused clothing range, with a clear display and prices that are easy to see.
venues.beyond: Food and film are also part of the centre's offer. People can combine a meal or a cinema visit with time in the shops.
venues.unknown: Space is offered on several floors. Storage, fitting rooms and the shops next to each space depend on the proposal. Visitor information is available on enquiry.
venues.terms: A 35 m² space for a small product range and sales counter. The setup price covers movable rails, signs and a mirror. A fitting area and extra storage are available by agreement. Staff, stock, payment equipment, electricity and taxes cost extra.

venues.name: Siam Paragon
venues.line: A prominent place to be seen.
venues.access: BTS Siam, Exit 3: about 1–2 minutes on foot by a direct station link. Both BTS lines stop here.
venues.intro: Show your brand in a well-known Bangkok shopping centre with international fashion, restaurants and entertainment.
venues.character: Siam Paragon is known for luxury fashion. It also has brands such as H&M, Uniqlo, Zara and United Arrows. Visitors can find both luxury labels and everyday clothing in the same centre.
venues.neighbourhood: Siam Paragon is in a busy fashion and shopping area. Siam Center and Siam Discovery are nearby, while Siam Square offers smaller shops and cafés. Visitors can explore several shopping destinations in one trip.
venues.business: A fashion shop here puts a collection in a setting with well-known brands and high-quality displays. Spaces on different floors offer different surroundings and nearby shops.
venues.beyond: Home products, technology, beauty, food and entertainment add to the fashion offer. Visitors have many reasons to spend time at the centre.
venues.unknown: The floor, display design and signs are agreed with each brand. Promotional support and details of nearby shops are available with the space proposal.
venues.terms: A 45 m² space with a product display, sales counter and small fitting area. The setup price includes a finished counter, display lighting and branded panels. Staff, stock, payment equipment, electricity and taxes cost extra.

venues.name: Central Embassy
venues.line: A considered setting for your brand.
venues.access: BTS Phloen Chit, Exit 5: about 2 minutes on foot by a covered station link. No main-road crossing is needed.
venues.intro: Present your brand in a stylish setting with luxury fashion, design, food and hotel services.
venues.character: Central Embassy brings together international and Thai fashion, beauty, design and restaurants. Its curved building and open interior are part of the experience.
venues.neighbourhood: Phloen Chit brings together premium shopping, restaurants and hotels. Park Hyatt Bangkok is above Central Embassy. On Level 6, Open House adds books, food and shared spaces to the shopping experience.
venues.business: A smaller shop can offer time for customers to explore products and talk with staff. Display units, lighting and packaging can form part of a complete brand experience in this luxury setting.
venues.beyond: Open House adds books, dining and places to meet. The centre also offers services such as personal shopping and language support.
venues.unknown: Space design and opening dates are agreed with each brand. Details of visitors and the number of people passing each space are available on enquiry.
venues.terms: A 40 m² space with product displays, a small fitting area and a table for customer appointments. The setup price includes display units and lighting. Staff, stock, payment equipment, electricity and taxes cost extra.
